ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_pairwise_advantage_sigmoid_signed_logsigmoid
ir.intuition: This loss shifts from margin-based ranking to a probability-based logistic framework, leveraging a signed advantage signal to directly modulate the log-probability difference between winner and loser. By applying logsigmoid on a scaled signed margin, it softly encourages alignment between predicted log-probabilities and pairwise preferences. The weighting uses the signed advantage difference directly, allowing the loss to distinguish not only preference magnitude but preference direction, providing a nuanced gradient signal. Aggregation is sum-based for emphasis on cumulative preference violation magnitude.
ir.pseudocode:
lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
adv_w = batch['advantage_w']
adv_l = batch['advantage_l']
weight = batch.get('weight', ones_like(lpw))
signed_adv = adv_w - adv_l
margin = alpha * (lpw - lpl)
signed_margin = margin * sign(signed_adv)
x = clamp(signed_margin, -20, 20)
loss = -logsigmoid(x) * abs(signed_adv)
if weight exists:
  loss *= weight
final_loss = sum(loss)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    adv_w = batch['advantage_w']
    adv_l = batch['advantage_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))
    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))
    signed_adv = ops.sub(adv_w, adv_l)
    margin = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    scaled_margin = ops.mul(alpha, margin)
    signed_margin = ops.mul(scaled_margin, ops.sign(signed_adv))
    clamped_margin = ops.clamp(signed_margin, -20.0, 20.0)
    loss = ops.mul(-ops.logsigmoid(clamped_margin), ops.abs(signed_adv))
    loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)
    return ops.sum(loss)
